package.name: fly_brain
package.description: Bio-inspired fly-brain controllers (haltere gyro reflex, optic-flow visual reflex, descending fusion). Ships a header-only, synthetic-input-tested algorithm library (mixer, complementary filter, haltere reflex law, Reichardt EMD + LPTC pooling, baseline cascaded-PID math, descending fusion law) consumed by fly_controller's BaselinePidController (M1) and, from M2 onward, by this package's own pluginlib-exported ros2_control chainable controller plugins (not yet implemented).
